notes: Original allottee No. 208 of the Pine Ridge Reservation, South Dakota. Had constructed three room frame house, barn for five head of horses and one cow, well drilled and fenced the entire allotment at a total cost of $905.00. Would be glad to repurchase land at the same rate provided improvements were in same condition. Owing to husband's employment in Idaho she was forced to leave Pine Ridge. Had the Government retained this allotment in trust for her she would still be the owner thereof. Amount paid for taxes was never refunded. Financial status is good.
